subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt one of the conflicting fork PRs for this Feishu underscore-URL bug, or sponsor a fresh same-repository fix?
rationale: The bug remains valid and narrow, but current labels and conflicting linked fork candidates mean another automatic fix PR could add duplicate churn without a maintainer choosing the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Close or leave the conflicting fork PRs as source context, then queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh one fork PR
options.body: Pick the better fork candidate, resolve conflicts, and require the same focused coverage and real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor update
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch into a mergeable, proven state.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Close or leave the conflicting fork PRs as source context, then queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with regression tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path work makes this the strongest current routing candidate for choosing the fix path.
